book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: APOCALIPSIS Tayta Dios ricatsingancunata apostol Juan gellgangan

content: Tsaypitanam ricargä gloria puncu quicharaycagta. Nircurnam puntata wiyangänölla yapaypis wiyargä cornëta gayaragnörä: “Cayman shamuy. Cananmi ricatsishayqui ima päsananpä cagtapis” nimagta.
Tsaychömi Espiritu Santo ricatsimargan mandacogpa jamaräcunan trönu gloriachö caycagta.

Tsay trönuchömi Tayta Dios jamaraycargan verdi y puca color lindu chipipirrä. Jaspi ruminö o cornalina ruminörämi chipipiycargan. Tsay jamacunan trönun jananpanan esmeralda ruminörä chipipiycag turmanyuy sutaraycargan.

Tayta Diospa trönuntam jiruruparäyargan ishcay chunca chuscu (24) mandagcuna jamacuyänan sillëtacuna. Tsay sillëtacunamanmi yullag röpashga respitashga runacuna jamacuyargan. Tsay respitashga runacunaga örupita coronashgam llapanpis cayargan.

Tayta Dios jamaraycangan trönunpitam atsicyaypa atsicyar tillagucuy yargamurgan. Magacuypis bunruruypam bunrururgan. Tsay trönupa ñöpanchömi ganchis (7) chiuchicuna rauraycäyargan. Tsaycunaga cargan Tayta Diospa Espiritu Santunmi.
Tsaynöpis Tayta Diospa trönun ñöpanchömi lamar maytsayninpa alëri ricacargan. Y nircur chuscu angelcunam tsay trönupa ñöpanchö caycäyargan. Tsay angelcunapam entëru cuerpunchö ñawincuna cargan.
Punta cag angelmi cargan leonnö. Ishcay cagnam törunö. Quimsa cagnam runanö. Y chuscu cagnam cargan älasnin quichashga condornö.
Tsaycunapaga chuscunpapis jogtayanmi älasnincuna capuyargan. Y entëru cuerpuncunachömi ñawincuna cargan. Tsay angelcunam pagasta junagtapis caynö nicäyan:

content.text: Gamga imaypitapis imayyagpis cawag Diosmi canqui” nir.

content: Trönunchö jamaraycag imayyagpis cawag Tayta Diosta tsaynö alabayaptinmi tsay ishcay chunca chuscu (24) respitashga runacunapis gonguricuycur adorayan. Y nircurmi corönancunata jipisquir Tayta Diospa ñöpanman churaycurnin niyan:

content.text: Tsaymi gamtaga llapanpis respitayäshur alabayäshunqui” nir.
